answer: Rhythm-gated admission. Each identity must emit periodic keep-alive traffic whose inter-arrival timing matches a per-agent schedule; the coordinator treats deviations in that pulse as a signal of duplication. Agents that arrive together or idle in lockstep are placed in a quarantine lagoon until their schedules decorrelate, delaying admission. An attacker running N clones must stagger and maintain N independent timing schedules, costing continuous per-identity clock management and wasted idle bandwidth.
